title: Synthesis of indenones via photo-induced radical cascade cyclization of alkynes with alkyl halides
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,33962-33965
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05436B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiao Liu, Huadi Zhou, Xiaohu Yang, Zhen Wang
A radical cascade cyclization of aryl ynones with alkyl halides was established to synthesise alkylated indenones in yields of 43 to 83% under metal- and oxidant-free and room temperature conditions.
